verdict.rationale: Gazebo officially ships C++ libraries for direct use in developer applications, including gz-math, sdformat, gz-transport and a C++ Fuel client library, and plugin development targets the simulator itself. That covers only one of the four languages the story names, and there is no evidence of Python, TypeScript or Go SDKs or of an SDK spanning the whole platform. Missing for 10: official Python, TypeScript and Go SDKs; evidence of coverage across the full platform surface; independent corroboration of SDK quality.
